post.description: Traverse one level down a hierarchy: the direct children of a cause, location or rei node (e.g. GBD region Western Europe to its 24 countries), plus the parent node and its ancestors.

type.description:
Hierarchical entity type.

Provider reference: allowed values ["cause", "location", "rei"].

id.description: Parent node id, e.g. location 73 (Western Europe), cause 294 (All causes), rei 169 (All risk factors).

gbd_round.description:
GBD round served by the Results tool: 2021 (gbd2021.healthdata.org) or 2023 (vizhub.healthdata.org, current release). Pinned on every record.

Provider reference: allowed values ["2021", "2023"].

proxy.description: Optional runner proxy override {kind: datacenter|residential|mobile, country?, sticky?}. Staging leases datacenter only.

200.description:
Traverse one level down a hierarchy: the direct children of a cause, location or rei node (e.g. GBD region Western Europe to its 24 countries), plus the parent node and its ancestors.

The response contains the tool result directly.

The provider identifies `records` as the primary payload key.

| Documented field | Provider type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `type` | string | cause \| location \| age \| sex \| measure \| metric \| rei. |
| `id` | number | Stable GBD entity id, shared across rounds. |
| `name` | string |  |
| `parent_id` | number | Parent in the hierarchy; null for roots, flat types and entities outside the tree. |
| `level` | number | Depth in its tree, 0 = root. |
| `iso3` | string | Always null: the tool publishes no ISO3 codes. |
| `gbd_round` | number |  |
| `version_id` | number |  |
| `source_updated_at` | string | Version release stamp in UTC, or null. |
| `tree` | string | gbd (official hierarchy), custom (IHME custom region groups) or null. |
| `rei_type` | string | risk \| etiology \| impairment \| injury n-codes for rei records; null otherwise. |
| `short_name` | string |  |
| `most_detailed` | boolean | Source most_detailed flag, or null when absent. |
| `sort_order` | number | Source sort order, or null. |
| `children_count` | number |  |
| `child_ids` | number[] |  |
| `source` | object | Raw php/metadata/ entry preserved verbatim (codes such as cause "B.2.2", sex flags, populations). |
| `source_url` | string |  |
| `observed_at_ms` | number |  |


These are the provider's documented fields. Field requiredness, nullability and nested object structures are specified only where the descriptions explicitly say so.

Entity type to list.

GBD round served by the Results tool: 2021 (gbd2021.healthdata.org) or 2023 (vizhub.healthdata.org, current release). Pinned on every record.

Provider reference: allowed values ["2021", "2023"].

page_size.description:
Records per page.

Provider reference: minimum 1; maximum 1000; default 200.

cursor.description: next_cursor from the previous page of the same type and gbd_round.

proxy.description: Optional runner proxy override {kind: datacenter|residential|mobile, country?, sticky?}. Staging leases datacenter only.
